def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # separator: uniform column whose color differs from the background
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for row in g for x in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    sep=None
    for c in range(w):
        col={g[r][c] for r in range(h)}
        if len(col)==1 and col!={bg}:
            sep=c; sepc=col.pop(); break
    left=[row[:sep] for row in g]
    right=[row[sep+1:] for row in g]
    sw=len(left[0])
    shared=(set(x for row in left for x in row) & set(x for row in right for x in row))
    shared.discard(bg); shared.discard(sepc)
    outc=shared.pop()
    return [[3 if left[r][c]==right[r][c] else outc for c in range(sw)] for r in range(h)]
